title: Stromrichterschaltungen mit verteilten Energiespeichern
version: German patent application publication DE 101 03 031 A1, published 25 July 2002, with filed date 24 January 2001

passages.note: The front matter dates the filing to 24 January 2001. The claims place individually switchable capacitor stores in the converter phase assemblies and describe series-connected subsystems.
